privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires processing 58 California counties. The input files are /home/ga/GIS_Data/epa_pm25_monitors_ca.geojson and /home/ga/GIS_Data/ca_counties.geojson. The final GeoJSON must be saved to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/pm25_coverage_gaps.geojson and the CSV to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/monitoring_coverage_report.csv. Required fields in the output are: monitor_count, nearest_monitor_km, coverage_status, and monitoring_density. Coverage status logic: 'Optimal' (count > 3), 'Sufficient' (1-3), 'Gap' (0).
